returnTitle.zh: 小微盘的历史收益有多高？

returnIntro.en: This reconstructed 400-stock China A-share series compounds rapidly over the published period. Explore its path, then inspect the losses along the way.
returnIntro.zh: 这份中国 A 股400只股票的规则重建序列，在样本期内增长很快。沿着曲线查看历史净值，再看看期间经历的损失。

cagr.zh: 这份重建序列的年化收益率

scope.en: A historical rule reconstruction before trading costs. Not a verified account or executable return. Price limits and capacity are not modeled; the final year is partial.
scope.zh: 历史规则重建，未计交易成本。组合账目与实际成交收益待核验，未处理涨跌停及容量，末年样本尚未完整。

nav.en: Growth of 1 from the first observation
nav.zh: 首个观测值归一为1的净值

scale.en: Logarithmic scale · equal vertical distances represent equal proportional changes. Hover or use the arrow keys to inspect a date.
scale.zh: 纵轴采用对数刻度，相同高度表示相同涨跌比例。移动指针或按左右方向键查看日期。

calculation.en: CAGR uses the last NAV divided by the first published NAV, annualized by elapsed calendar days (365.2425 days per year). The curve is rebased only for display. It does not establish a persistent size premium.
calculation.zh: 年化收益率按末值与首个已发布净值的比值计算，以实际日历天数折年，每年取365.2425天。曲线仅为展示归一化。单独这段序列还不能证明规模溢价持续存在。

drawdownIntro.en: The same series lost more than half its value from a previous peak at its deepest point. Select 2024 to inspect that episode, with earlier peaks retained in the calculation.
drawdownIntro.zh: 同一份序列在最深回撤时，较此前高点跌去了超过一半。选择2024年可以查看那段下跌，计算仍保留此前的历史高点。

drawdownMetric.en: Maximum drawdown over the full sample

costIntro.en: Adjust the spread and replacement fraction below. Shorter holding intervals repeat trading costs more often. This separate scenario illustrates a cost hurdle; it is not a net-return estimate for the curve above.
costIntro.zh: 拖动下面的价差和替换比例。持有周期越短，同样的成本就会发生得越频繁。这里单独演示成本门槛，不能据此算出上方曲线的净收益。

continueIntro.en: Follow the investigations, compare sources and see which questions remain open.
continueIntro.zh: 接着读具体调查，对照文献，看看哪些问题还没有答案。

followHint.en: Scroll to advance the chart. Adjusting a chart pauses the guide.
followHint.zh: 向下滚动推进图表，直接操作图表可暂停跟随。

freeHint.en: Charts are independent. Turn on scroll following to resume the guide.
freeHint.zh: 现在可以独立查看图表，开启跟随滚动可继续导览。

earlyBody.en: The curve begins in January 2015. Its initial published value is rebased to 1 here. Scrolling reveals the observations already in the source; the axes stay fixed.
earlyBody.zh: 曲线从2015年1月开始，首个已发布净值在图中归一为1。随着滚动，图中逐步显示已有观测，坐标范围保持不变。

middleBody.en: The path extends through 2020. A logarithmic scale gives the same height to the same proportional gain, so early movements remain visible.
middleBody.zh: 曲线延伸到2020年。对数刻度让相同涨跌比例占据相同高度，早期波动仍然看得清。

wholeBody.en: The full period ends on September 4, 2026. The figure below annualizes the endpoint change across that entire period. Trading costs and executable portfolio accounting remain unverified.
wholeBody.zh: 完整样本截至2026年9月4日。下方数字按整段样本的首尾变化计算年化收益率，交易成本和可成交组合账目仍待核验。

riskWholeTitle.en: Measure the distance from a previous peak
riskWholeTitle.zh: 看看离此前高点有多远

riskWholeBody.en: Each point shows the loss from the highest NAV observed up to that date. Zero means the series is at its running high. The largest full-sample loss is shown below.
riskWholeBody.zh: 每个点表示当日净值相对此前最高净值的跌幅。回到零，表示净值到达历史高点。下方是完整样本的最大回撤。

risk2024Body.en: This window selects 2024 while retaining earlier peaks and the same vertical scale. The early-year plunge and later movements belong to one continuous series.
risk2024Body.zh: 这里选出2024年的观测，保留此前高点和相同的纵轴刻度。年初下跌与后续走势仍属于同一条连续序列。

riskContextBody.en: The full sample returns to view. Compare the 2024 episode with earlier drawdowns. Reaching a new high in this reconstruction does not establish that every holding could be sold on the way.
riskContextBody.zh: 图表重新展示完整样本，可以把2024年与此前的回撤放在一起看。重建净值后来创出新高，也不能证明当时每只持仓都能卖出。

costBaseBody.en: At a 50-basis-point spread and 100% replacement, trading every 21 sessions implies a 6% annual arithmetic cost hurdle. The bars also show 5- and 63-session intervals.
costBaseBody.zh: 假设完整价差为50基点，每轮替换全部持仓，每21个交易日买卖一轮，年度算术成本门槛为6%。图中也列出5天和63天的间隔。

costWideBody.en: The spread rises to 100 basis points. With the same replacement fraction and interval, the 21-session hurdle rises to 12%. These are assumptions, not observed execution costs.
costWideBody.zh: 价差扩大到100基点。替换比例与间隔不变，21天情景的成本门槛升至12%。这些是假设输入，尚未对应实测成交成本。

costHalfBody.en: Keep the 100-basis-point spread and replace 50% each round trip. The 21-session hurdle returns to 6%. Changing turnover can also change strategy returns; this calculator does not model that effect.
costHalfBody.zh: 价差维持100基点，每轮替换比例降为50%，21天情景的成本门槛回到6%。换手变化也可能改变策略收益，这个计算器没有模拟那部分影响。

staticHint.en: This viewport uses normal reading flow. The chart remains available for exploration.
staticHint.zh: 当前窗口采用普通排版，仍可直接操作图表查看数据。
